name: @@agent_id@@
description: Private Data Productization Agent trial with Codex, DataOS CLI and live Vulcan runtime

arguments:
set +x
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
export HOME=/etc/dataos/work/home
export DATAOS_CONFIG_DIRECTORY=/etc/dataos/work/cli-config
export PATH=/etc/dataos/work/bin:$PATH
export SHELL=/bin/bash
export GIT_ASKPASS=/etc/dataos/work/git-askpass
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
mkdir -p "$HOME" /etc/dataos/work/runtime /etc/dataos/work/project
printf '%s' '@@FILE:start-agent.sh@@' | base64 -d > /etc/dataos/work/start-codex.sh
chmod 700 /etc/dataos/work/start-codex.sh
npm install --prefix /etc/dataos/work/runtime --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @@codex_package@@
ln -sfn /etc/dataos/work/runtime/node_modules/.bin/codex /etc/dataos/work/bin/codex
codex --version
printf '%s' '@@FILE:vulcan-broker.py@@' | base64 -d > /etc/dataos/work/vulcan-broker.py
printf '%s' '@@FILE:vulcan.js@@' | base64 -d > /etc/dataos/work/bin/vulcan
chmod 700 /etc/dataos/work/bin/vulcan

@@RUNTIME_FILES@@
export VULCAN_DOCS=/etc/dataos/work/agent/docs
export AGENT_TOOLS=/etc/dataos/work/agent/tools.md
dataos-ctl develop assist lab --help > /etc/dataos/work/agent/cli-lab-help.txt 2>&1
if ! grep -q -- '--subpath' /etc/dataos/work/agent/cli-lab-help.txt; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG: selected DataOS CLI image lacks the lab transport capability.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
dataos-ctl develop assist mcp run --help > /etc/dataos/work/agent/cli-mcp-help.txt 2>&1
codex --help > /etc/dataos/work/agent/model-help.txt 2>&1
# One shared product collection, provisioned by the operator.
if [ ! -d /etc/dataos/work/project/.git ]; then
  git clone --single-branch --branch "$(cat /etc/dataos/work/git-branch)" "$(cat /etc/dataos/work/git-url)" /etc/dataos/work/project
fi

printf '%s' '@@FILE:git-askpass.sh@@' | base64 -d > /etc/dataos/work/git-askpass
chmod 700 /etc/dataos/work/git-askpass
exec dataos-ctl develop assist lab --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --subpath /@@agent_id@@ --dir /etc/dataos/work/project --agent codex --cmd /etc/dataos/work/start-codex.sh --allowed-users @@operator_id@@
